producer_report.summary: Added a [landing] table with merge_via_rest = true to athena.toml, with a comment giving the reason (owner set the repo squash-only with a ruleset on main and approved merging verified work once required checks pass). Root cause: the test pinned this repository's live setting (it asserted athena.toml has no [landing] table) instead of the default. The test now asserts the repo config turns the merge on. It strips the [landing] table from REPO_CONFIG line by line, asserts the default is off on that stripped base, and checks that an explicit true and an empty [landing] table still behave as before. Added a CHANGELOG entry.

checks_run.note: Ran as `cargo test --locked -q` the second time. Every suite is ok, 0 failed. I did not see the config test named in the output.

open_issues: The brief's criterion 6 says only athena.toml and config.rs change, but its deliverables list also names CHANGELOG.md. I changed all three.
mistakes: The first full `cargo test` output was too large and got saved to a file outside the working directory. A Grep on it was denied, so I stopped and reran with -q instead.
learnings: REPO_CONFIG in config.rs is include_str! of the repo's athena.toml, so edits to athena.toml affect tests.
CHANGELOG.md has several '### Added' headings, so an edit needs more context to be unique.
